name: EMUN investiční společnost
decision_note: Licensed investment company / multi-family office whose private-markets products (e.g. EMUN Global Unicorns, launched Oct 2025) are funds of funds that buy company exposure through other funds and SPVs - an indirect (LP-only) investor, E5.

evidence.quote: EMUN investiční společnost, a.s. je česká multi-family office platforma pro významné rodinné a institucionální investory.
Nabízí služby v oblasti plánování nástupnictví, správy majetku, diskrečního portfolio managementu a investičních fondů.

evidence.publisher: EMUN investiční společnost (EMUN Global Unicorns teaser, 08/2026)
evidence.quote: Fond bude nakupovat podíly ve společnostech skrze účasti ve fondech a investičních SPV

evidence.publisher: EMUN investiční společnost (EMUN Global Unicorns statute)
evidence.quote: Z pohledu struktury aktiv patří Fond mezi fondy fondů.
Fond EMUN Global Private Credit (GPC) investuje do fondů zaměřených na zajištěné akviziční úvěry a další private credit nástroje mimo veřejné trhy.

analyst_notes: Self-described family office (emun.cz) managing private portfolios of individuals, families and foundations, diversified across capital markets and alternatives; first ČNB-licensed institutional trustee; manages over CZK 16bn (site) / over CZK 10bn at 2024-12-31 (CVCA profile). It manages clients' wealth for fees rather than investing its own capital directly in private companies, so it is excluded as a service provider (E1). If evidence of direct private-company investments is found, it could instead be typed family_office (S1). [revision 2026-10-25 after review: rule_codes E1 -> E5. EMUN's private-markets vehicles invest indirectly: EMUN Global Unicorns (late-stage 'unicorn' exposure, launched Oct 2025, >CZK 200m per the reviewer; NAV USD 32.6m at 2026-09-30 on the fund page) buys stakes 'through participations in funds and investment SPVs' (e3) and is legally a fund of funds (e4); the private-credit fund likewise invests in other funds (e5). No direct startup investment by EMUN was found, so E5 (LP-only) fits better than E1; the wealth-management / family-office business (e1, e2) is unchanged.]
